appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.help: Applies instantly on this device. Saved in this browser.

refresh.title: Refresh rate
refresh.help: How often every unit is polled for GPU, CPU, memory, network and LLM metrics, and how often the dashboard updates. Remote units are polled over SSH, so 1s costs the most; storage and liveness keep their own slower checks.

sessionAge.title: Session age
sessionAge.help: Hide harness sessions older than this. The oldest choice is 14 days. There is no unlimited value.

harnessSessions.title: Harness sessions
harnessSessions.help: One helper on each machine lists OpenClaw, OpenCode, oh-my-pi, Hermes and DeepSeek Harness. The dashboard only stores the helper address and token.

healthTemps.title: GPU temperature alerts
healthTemps.help: Health warns when the hottest GPU reaches the first value and turns critical at the second, in °C whatever the display unit. Alert notifications use the same limits. Defaults 85 and 90; the warning must be lower than critical.

timeZone.title: Time zone
timeZone.help: Hour and day boundaries and labels on the Tokens, Energy and Activity charts. Empty follows this browser ({{timeZone}}). Daily token buckets and monthly energy totals stay UTC.

defaultLlmPort.title: Default LLM port
defaultLlmPort.help: Pre-filled when adding a new Spark (1–65535).

hideWorkers.title: Hide worker nodes
hideWorkers.help: Removes Worker-role Sparks from Overview and the sidebar. Direct URLs and batch power / Hermes actions still include them.

overviewSearch.title: Show search and status filters
overviewSearch.help: Overview search field and status dropdown (All / Online / Offline / Issues). Off by default.

benchShareImage.title: Benchmark share image
benchShareImage.help: The decode/prefill Copy results button gains a caret with Copy as text / Copy as image (a share card). Turn it off to keep the plain text button.

vramBreakdown.title: Detailed VRAM breakdown
vramBreakdown.help: VRAM bars split memory into LLM engine, system and free, and turn amber or red on low free memory rather than on a high percentage. Turn it off for the single percentage bar.

prometheus.title: Prometheus metrics
prometheus.help: Serves every unit's metrics for Prometheus / Grafana to scrape at {{origin}}/metrics. Off by default.

intelVramSudo.title: Intel Arc VRAM via sudo
intelVramSudo.help: Reads exact Intel Arc VRAM use from root-only debugfs with sudo -n on each host. Off by default: VRAM then shows the PCI BAR size and nothing runs with sudo.

metricsHistory.title: Metrics history
metricsHistory.help: Keeps 48 hours of 1-minute and 30 days of 15-minute history per unit on the server (GPU, memory headroom, CPU, network, LLM tok/s and KV; at most about 1 MB per unit on disk) and charts it in a History panel on each unit's page. Off by default.

fleetEnergy.title: Show Fleet Energy
fleetEnergy.help: Overview card with rolling fleet power estimates. The full Fleet energy page is always available from the sidebar.

llmTokenTotals.title: Show LLM Token Totals
llmTokenTotals.help: Overview card with cumulative prompt/generated tokens per model. The full Token totals page is always available from the sidebar.

recentActivity.title: Show Recent activity
recentActivity.help: Overview card with the latest health and kernel events. The full Activity page is always available from the sidebar.

fleetDecode.title: Show Fleet decode tile
fleetDecode.help: Overview tile with the fleet's total generation tok/s.

fleetPower.title: Show Fleet power tile
fleetPower.help: Overview tile with the fleet's total power draw.

memoryInUse.title: Show Memory in use tile
memoryInUse.help: Overview tile with the fleet's total memory in use.

tokens24Hours.title: Show Tokens in last 24 hours tile
tokens24Hours.help: Overview tile with the tokens generated in the last 24 hours (or the online unit count, when no tokens are tracked yet).

fleetExceptions.title: Show active fleet exceptions
fleetExceptions.help: Overview strip for offline hosts, GPU throttle, disk, LLM, and Tailnet alerts. Off by default.

benchDebugTraces.title: Save benchmark debug traces
benchDebugTraces.help: Stores prompts, HTTP/completion IDs, content previews, and GPU samples in bench history. Off by default; larger history files.

electricityPrice.title: Electricity price
electricityPrice.help: Per kWh, used for the estimated cost on the Fleet energy page. Leave empty to hide cost.

alertNotifications.title: Alert notifications
alertNotifications.help: Send Health findings and Overview exceptions to ntfy, Discord, Slack or a webhook once they hold for a while, and when they clear. Off by default.

tabBadge.title: Tab badge
tabBadge.help: The tab title shows how many fleet alerts are active — offline units, throttling, storage, LLM and Health — as “(2) sparkDash”, and the icon gets a red (critical) or amber dot. Counts all of them even when “Show active fleet exceptions” is off. This browser only; saved immediately.

desktop.title: Desktop notifications
desktop.help: A notification when a fleet alert becomes active (any kind, as for the tab badge), while this page is open. This browser only; saved immediately.
desktop.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in the browser's site settings, then turn this on again.
desktop.refused: This browser refused the notification permission request.
desktop.insecure: Browsers only allow notifications on HTTPS or localhost, and this page is plain HTTP. Use an SSH tunnel, Tailscale Serve or an HTTPS proxy — or an ntfy channel under Alert notifications.
desktop.unsupported: This browser does not support desktop notifications.
desktop.withdrawn: Permission was withdrawn in the browser; nothing is shown until it is allowed again.

accessToken.title: Access token
accessToken.help: This browser's copy of the server's token, sent to servers that already require one. It cannot turn protection on: set SPARKDASH_TOKEN in the host's .env and recreate the container. Stored in this browser only.

errors.healthTempsRange: GPU temperature limits must be numbers between {{min}} and {{max}} °C.
errors.healthTempsOrder: The warning temperature must be lower than the critical temperature.
errors.invalidTimeZone: "{{timeZone}}" is not a known time zone (for example Europe/Paris), or clear the field to follow the browser.
errors.invalidMqttUrl: "{{url}}" is not a broker URL — use mqtt://host:1883 (or mqtts://, ws://, wss://), or clear the field.
errors.mqttCredentials: Remove the user name and password from the broker URL: put the user name in MQTT username and the password in the SPARKDASH_MQTT_PASSWORD environment variable.

publishing.title: MQTT publishing
publishing.help: Publishes the activity feed events and every unit's readings to your MQTT broker (Home Assistant, Node-RED, …) as they change. Off by default. The README's MQTT section lists the topics.

url.title: MQTT broker URL
url.help: mqtt://host:1883, mqtts:// for TLS, ws(s):// for a websocket broker. The password is read from the SPARKDASH_MQTT_PASSWORD environment variable, never stored in settings.json.

username.title: MQTT username
username.help: Leave empty for a broker that allows anonymous publish.

prefix.title: MQTT topic prefix
prefix.help: Topic root for everything published: PREFIX/events, PREFIX/status/… and PREFIX/metrics/…

gpuClock.title: GPU clock cap
gpuClock.help: Caps the GPU graphics clock on every Spark at once (nvidia-smi -lgc): pick the state they should be in — Full capacity or 1800–2400 MHz — and Save applies it. Offline or GPU-less units are skipped and reported.
gpuClock.unknown: No unit reports its clock right now — reopen Settings to try again.
gpuClock.nowCapped_one: Now: capped at {{mhz}} MHz on {{count}} unit{{unreadable}}
gpuClock.nowCapped_other: Now: capped at {{mhz}} MHz on {{count}} units{{unreadable}}
gpuClock.keepAfterReboot: Keep after reboot — the state you pick also installs a boot hook on each unit
gpuClock.persistenceUnavailable: Not offered here: these units have no boot hook the cap can use — neither a root shell for the boot service nor a running cron service for an @reboot job. The cap applies until the next reboot.
gpuClock.pending: Not applied yet — press Save to change every unit.
gpuClock.retryWithoutPersistence: Untick “Keep after reboot” to cap until the next reboot instead.
gpuClock.keptCron: — kept by an @reboot cron job on each unit
gpuClock.keptMixed: — kept after reboot (boot service or @reboot job, per unit)
gpuClock.incomplete: No unit completed the requested change — some changes may have applied{{skipped}}
